TRATON Financial Services BSU is part of TRATON Financial Services, supporting the TRATON brands in Romania and Bulgaria with dedicated financing and insurance solutions, contributing to their commercial success and long-term customer relationships.
 Role Summary
 Responsible for the day-to-day operation, administration, security and development of the local IT infrastructure and business-critical application environment for Romania and Bulgaria. The role acts as the primary local technical contact between business users, TFS/Scania central IT teams, external infrastructure providers, application vendors and auditors. 
 Job Responsibilities
 IT Infrastructure, Servers & Virtualization
Administer and maintain local Windows Server infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers.
Coordinate server provisioning, configuration, migrations, upgrades and troubleshooting.
Maintain production and test environments for Charisma ERP and supporting infrastructure.
Coordinate server-room infrastructure and physical infrastructure relocations.
Manage external IT infrastructure providers across both countries.
Maintain technical documentation, server inventories and infrastructure mappings.
 Microsoft SQL Server Administration
Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server environments.
Manage production and test databases.
Perform database backups, restores, cloning and refresh activities.
 Charisma ERP Technical Administration
Maintain production and test ERP environments.
Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate their resolution.
Manage users, roles and permissions.
Coordinate system releases and changes with TotalSoft.
 Identity & Access Management
Manage user accounts, access rights and permissions across local business systems.
Coordinate user onboarding, access changes and offboarding.
Administer roles and permissions in Charisma ERP and WEB Origination.
Perform periodic User Access Reviews and maintain access documentation.
Ensure compliance with least-privilege and access management principles.
 Network & Security
Coordinate LAN/WAN infrastructure and network requirements.
Manage VPN connectivity and remote access.
Coordinate site-to-site connectivity with external providers.
 IT Audit & Compliance
Act as the primary technical contact for IT audits related to local infrastructure and core applications.
Prepare and provide evidence for IT General Controls (ITGC) audits.
Support access management, change management and IT operations controls.
Address audit findings and coordinate remediation activities.
 Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
Coordinate backup procedures and ensure appropriate recovery processes.
Perform database restoration and recovery testing.
Maintain and restore test environments using available backups.
Support infrastructure and application recovery during incidents. 
 Who You Are
 You are passioned IT infrastructure professional with strong expertise across Windows Server, SQL Server, virtualization, networking, Microsoft 365 and Active Directory/Entra ID.
A pragmatic problem solver able to take end-to-end technical ownership of business-critical applications, infrastructure, access management and production/test environments, while effectively coordinating central IT teams, vendors and external providers.
A Security- and control-minded person, with a solid understanding of backup/DR, IAM and IT controls.
 It Would Be an Advantage If You Have:
Experience with Charisma ERP.
Knowledge of Snowflake.
Understanding of Power BI and data integration concepts.
Experience with Microsoft Intune/Autopilot.
Knowledge of RPA integration.
Experience with ITGC and audits.
Familiarity with NIS2, DORA, security and compliance requirements.
Additional relevant professional experience.
 This Is Us 
 Our team consists in 45 colleagues, located in different offices across Bulgaria and Romania, while the IT department is going to be formed of 2 colleagues, you will be one of them.
 Scania Offers 
 Scania Finance, part of TRATON Financial Services, is Scania's dedicated financial services partner, providing financing and insurance solutions tailored to our customers and their transport business. Joining us means becoming part of a global organization and premium brand, with the opportunity to work at the intersection of truck sales, financing and insurance. We offer a competitive salary and performance-based bonus scheme, an attractive benefits package, dedicated onboarding, continuous training and development opportunities, as well as exposure to challenging commercial projects in an international environment.
 Application 
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
Apply as soon as possible. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period.
 We look forward to your application!
